description: Parking. Urbà is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ide.cime.es. Aparcaments (parkings) urbans de Menorca. Aquesta capa s'ha creat a partir de la revisió de diverses capes del MTB 1:1000 de 2004 del Govern Balear i 1:500 de 2007 dels ajuntaments de Maó Ferreries i es Migjorn per ser utlitizada com a base de referència de la IDE Menorca. Coverage: ES. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
